34 weeks + 7 days = 34 × 7 + 7 = 245 days.  
1980-12-21 + 245 days: 1980 is leap year, so Dec 21 + 10 days → Dec 31 (10 days), remaining 235 days.  
235 days into 1981: Jan 31 days, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → sum to 243 days by Aug 31, need 235, so Aug 26, 1981.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1981-08-26
